store: Jeweller's Casket round 1: an open Viking-age casket on two hewn runners, low front, thirteen lined trays in three stepped rows (row 0 front: Gemstone blue, green, red, Crown jewel, spare; row 1: Ancient gemstone black, green, orange, purple; row 2 back: Ancient coin, Silver necklace, Pot shard green, Pot shard red); one item kind per tray, heaped and crowned over the rim when full

frame.atlas_sources: rows 0-31 hewn timber, 32-63 x0-63 end grain, 64-79 dark iron: assets/bunker_r4; 32-63 x64-95 dark oiled timber, x96-127 wear swatch: assets/metalpallet_r3; 80-111: undyed linen, dark felt, madder wool cloth (as treasure_r1), leather (new)

space: Unity prefab space, origin = footprint centre on the ground. Blender z-up/-y front -> Unity y-up/+z front: ux=-bx, uy=bz, uz=-by. OBJ export (forward NEGATIVE_Z, up Y) writes (bx, bz, -by); Unity's importer negates x, same mapping.
unit_semantics: SETTLED: every copy has an explicit final pose from a rigid-body simulation (convex-hull items, friction 0.75, restitution 0), dropped in batches onto the frozen earlier copies; each tray's copy sequence is cut into its units in drop order. Each copy: the item's bounds centre at unit.position + copy.offset (= copy.world_position), rotated by copy.quat_xyzw (or copy.euler, Unity ZXY), longest side fit_longest_m. unit.position = centre of unit.box = the bounding box of the unit's copies, its bottom lowered to the lowest rotated-bounds corner (the never-below-the-floor lift leaves every settled copy alone).
fill_order: units are listed in fill order (interleaved over the trays); within a tray its units fill bottom up. Show the first n copies of a unit for a partial stack. Later copies rest on earlier ones, earlier ones never move. One item kind per tray (unit.compartment = tray group, unit.item = its prefab; compartment 12 is the empty spare tray).

compartments.note: spare tray: lined and empty, holds no units; a kind without a tray of its own may take it

spare_note_runtime: compartment 12: units copied from 0 (shifted ['-0.996', '0.000', '0.000']), no home item, so overflow can land there (review 25 Oct)
